title: Write Address (AW) Handshake Violation
description: Crossbar deasserts AWREADY before the Master deasserts AWVALID, violating the AXI-Lite handshake rule that READY must hold until VALID is sampled.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [AXI_PROT_CHECK] AWREADY dropped before AWVALID handshake complete
expected_root_cause: The AW-channel READY logic is combinationally gated by an internal stall signal without a registered hold, causing READY to glitch low mid-handshake [1].
failure_log:
T=20ns: AWVALID=1, AWREADY=1
T=25ns: AWREADY=0 (premature)
UVM_ERROR: READY dropped mid-handshake.
success_log: AWREADY remains stable high until posedge clk samples AWVALID.
fix_replacement: always_ff @(posedge clk) begin if (!rst_n) awready <= 0; else awready <= !internal_stall; end
